domain: warehouse fulfillment and shared inventory allocation
title: Distributed Lock for a Shared Inventory Ledger
core_conflict: Two allocation agents are editing the same shared inventory ledger for a high-demand SKU, each working from its own stale local cache. An earlier concurrent write already silently overwrote a peer's reservation (a lost update), so the automated allocation view no longer matches the physical stock. A field photograph of the warehouse bay showing the true on-hand pallet count is the decisive proof of the real quantity; corroborated by the on-hand stock trend chart, it shows the ledger must be corrected. Because a second allocation agent is mid-edit from a stale cache, the coordinator must acquire an exclusive lock on the ledger before editing and release it afterwards so the peer's in-flight reservation is preserved rather than clobbered.
required_constraints: Blair Allocation Agent is editing the same shared inventory ledger from a stale local cache; an earlier concurrent write already silently overwrote a reservation (a lost update), so the coordinator must serialize access to the ledger rather than edit it directly.

The coordinator must visually read the true on-hand pallet count from the field photograph of the warehouse bay 'bay_pallet_photo.png' (the physically observed count on the bay), then inspect the on-hand stock trend chart, and write a reconciliation report '/reports/inventory_reconciliation.md' correlating the photographed count against the ledger to justify the correction.

Before editing the shared ledger the coordinator must acquire the exclusive lock with 'lock acquire --resource inventory_ledger' (checking 'lock status --resource inventory_ledger' first), apply the corrected on-hand count to the ledger file only while holding the lock, and then run 'lock release --resource inventory_ledger' once the edit is written; the coordinator must NOT edit the ledger while another holder owns the lock.

The coordinator's correction must preserve (not overwrite) Blair Allocation Agent's in-flight reservation; the reconciled ledger must reflect both the true on-hand count and the peer's still-valid reservation.

Casey Inventory Controller will commit the final allocation only after the coordinator sends a chat message citing the visually read on-hand count and confirming the ledger lock was released. Devon Warehouse Lead will not re-open the bay for picking until Casey confirms the commit.

evidence.summary: Field photograph of the warehouse bay showing the true on-hand pallet/unit count for the disputed SKU.
On-hand stock / allocation throughput trend chart corroborating that the ledger is out of sync with physical stock.
